brief: Today's UPSC Intelligence Brief covering critical developments in Climate Policy, Agriculture DPI, Deep Ocean Exploration, International Relations, and Digital Governance.

articles.title: Operationalization of Indian Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) Framework
articles.summary: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) releases final compliance standards and offset trading rules under the Indian Carbon Market.
prelims: CCTS is regulated by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) under the Ministry of Power.
Features a dual-structure framework: a mandatory Compliance Mechanism for obligated sectors and a Voluntary Offset Mechanism.
Carbon Credit Certificates (CCCs) will be issued and traded on power exchanges registered with CERC.
articles.mains: Examine the role of the Indian Carbon Market in accelerating industrial decarbonization and helping India achieve its NDC targets under the Paris Agreement.

articles.title: Nationwide Rollout of AgriStack under the Digital Agriculture Mission
articles.summary: Ministry of Agriculture expands AgriStack to enable seamless, target-oriented delivery of agricultural services and institutional credit.
prelims: AgriStack provides a unique digital identity ('Farmer ID') linked with Aadhaar and land records.
Core foundational elements include Farmers' Registry, Geo-referenced Village Maps, and Digital Crop Surveys.
Designed to integrate with PM-KISAN, PM Fasal Bima Yojana, and priority sector lending mechanisms.
articles.mains: Discuss how Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) in agriculture can resolve information asymmetry, facilitate formal credit access, and modernize crop insurance in India.

articles.title: Harbor Trials Completed for Deep Ocean Submersible 'MATSYA 6000'
articles.source: Down To Earth / Press Information Bureau
articles.summary: National Institute of Ocean Technology conducts key phase trials for India's indigenous manned submersible under the Deep Ocean Mission.
prelims: MATSYA 6000 is an indigenous manned submersible designed to dive up to 6,000 meters with 3 crew members.
Developed by the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT), Chennai, under the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
Aims to explore deep-sea resources such as polymetallic nodules containing nickel, cobalt, copper, and manganese.
articles.mains: Analyze the strategic, economic, and scientific implications of the Deep Ocean Mission for India's Blue Economy strategy.

articles.title: Resumption of Negotiations for India-GCC Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement
articles.summary: India and the Gulf Cooperation Council advance negotiations to finalize a comprehensive pact boosting energy cooperation and trade.
prelims: The GCC is a regional economic and political union comprising UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, and Bahrain.
GCC collective status represents one of India's largest regional trade partners and key supplier of crude oil and LNG.
Framework Agreement on Economic Cooperation between India and the GCC was originally signed in 2004.
articles.mains: How does India's 'Think West' policy align with GCC countries' economic diversification plans (e.g., Saudi Vision 2030, UAE Centennial)? Discuss.

articles.title: Notification of Rules Governing the Data Protection Board under DPDP Act
articles.summary: Union Government notifies operational frameworks detailing the jurisdiction, digital functioning, and penalty adjudication process of the Data Protection Board.
prelims: The Data Protection Board of India is established as an independent, 'digital-by-design' adjudicatory body.
Distinguishes entities between Data Fiduciaries (entities deciding purpose of processing) and Data Processors.
Appeals against the decisions of the Data Protection Board lie with the Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal (TDSAT).
articles.mains: Evaluate the institutional structure of the Data Protection Board in safeguarding citizen data privacy while promoting administrative ease for digital businesses.
